dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking to buy a book, but I have a few specific things I'm looking for. Could you tell me what books you have that are under $15? Also, I'd love something in the comic or mystery genre.
dialogue.agent:
Great choices! Here are some books under $15 I found:

**Comic options:**
- **The Incredible Hulk #275** — $7.99 ⭐ 5.0 (1 review)
- **Superman #28 CVR A** — $7.29 ⭐ 5.0 (1 review)

products.title: Max's Midnight Swirl
products.description: About the Author Jane Brandi Johnson has shown a passion for writing since creating comic strips in her Geneva, Illinois home at age 8. She is now an award-winning editor and children's author. A graduate of Boston University, Jane enjoyed a lifetime of business ownership along with a 15-year career teaching English in the Florida School System. She now devotes her time to fundraising, writing children's books, and enjoying every sport imaginable! Jane is a world traveler who believes that visiting other cultures is the most direct road to wisdom. She is the mother of two grown children and lives in Tampa with her husband, Dale.

products.title: Little Moments of Love
products.description: About the Author Catana Chetwynd is a self-taught traditional artist and the enthusiastic author of Catana Comics. She grew up in Saratoga Springs, New York, where she spent her time creating art and pursuing an education in psychology until accidentally stumbling into the world of comics. Not only is her fiancé, John, the daily inspiration for her drawings, but he was also the one who suggested a comic series about their relationship in the first place. Thanks to his idea and his inspiring daily antics, Catana was able to pursue her childhood dream of being a cartoonist. She currently lives on the East Coast with John and their tiny, angry dog, Murph.

products.title: Tom Swift Lives! Rocket Ship (Tom Swift reimagined!)
The Missing Bombardier: A Short Story
Helen's Orphans (Troy to Rome)
products.description: Review "The love story of Timon and Lukas offers the most joyous, tender and poignant sections of this imaginative novel. Proficient, modern prose and dialogue, enhanced by lifestyle details, make an ancient epic especially accessible. An enjoyable, inventive Trojan War tale with an intriguing final twist and a serious message." Kirkus Reviews "Tender, compelling, dazzling. History, myth, intrigue, and long-buried secrets mark this beautifully told story. Fritsch's extraordinary storytelling abilities shine as he brings to life the larger-than-life heroes and villains of the Trojan War. The skillfully evoked era and meticulously researched period details, combined with the crisp, straightforward prose and smoothly paced narrative make for a page-turning story pulsing with romance, sacrifice, conspiracies, betrayals, and battles. Lovers of Greek mythology and historical fiction won't want to miss this one." The Prairies Book Review "Fritsch crafts a detailed and immersive fiction that is charming in its minute detail. Helen's point-of-view passages give the legend charm and agency. Fritsch's new spin on a timeless tale will draw in readers with his sympathetic characterization and original inventions." BookLife Reviews "Fritsch did an amazing job creating this story. I really enjoyed reading it and did so in a single sitting. Fans of Greek mythology and ancient history will really enjoy this novel." Reader Views "Fritsch spins a complex web of secrets and revelations that keep the reader engaged throughout. His plot lines are constantly moving forward toward an inevitable collision. His ability to objectively examine alternative angles of a classical work is commendable." US Review of Books From the Author Helen's Orphans has won the gold medal in the LGBTQIA category of the 2020-2021 Reader Views Literary Awards. The novel has won a finalist award in the 2021 Book Excellence Awards. From the Back Cover Did Helen choose to run off to Troy with Paris, or did he force her togo with him? Two orphans of the Trojan War, the tragic conflict Helen'selopement or abduction precipitated, search for the answer to one of the oldest questions in history--and discover much more. About the Author Fritsch has written ten award-winning novels, mainly in the historical fiction and mystery genres. Read more

products.title: Crossroads of Life: How An Introvert Triumphs in An Extroverted World
products.description: Review "Crossroads of Life is a unique take on what makes a relationship persevere, and the author's emphasis on introversion adds to the story's originality. Bhattacharjee offers a creative and meditative plot focused on making sense of internal struggles and navigating the decision-making that impacts life events. The prose is beautifully metaphoric at times, evoking arresting images juxtaposed with lyrical writing. Bhattacharjee's narrative approach empowers the novel's characterization, and the story's introspective commentary is a powerful thread weaving the different elements together."...The BookLife Prize

top_reviews.title: Max's swirl to the top of children's books
top_reviews.text:
The writing of a prodigious Ph.D. dissertation is a piece of cake compared to the insight and innovation that are required to create an outstanding children's book. Max's Midnight Swirl is one such example, and it is destined to become a classic!The beauty is found in the compelling simplicity of the basic idea, the inviting writing, and the imaginative graphic design of the wonderful personalities in Max's dream. I recommend this Prince of Children's Books for the young and those who love and guide them.

Gary H. Quehl, Ph.D.

top_reviews.title: Retired teacher and now volunteer!
top_reviews.text:
As a retired Kindergarten and 1st Grade Teacher, I would have enjoyed reading this book to my classes. With it's colorful illustrations of all the different kinds of animals, the limited amount of print on each page and the rhyming sentences, it is perfect for early listeners and readers. It's a book that will stimulate the imagination of children and inspire them to write their own stories. For teachers, it's an excellent example to teach rhyming, character personalities of the animals, beginning, middle and end - and many more literacy examples.

As a volunteer next school year, I will definitely be reading this to students!
